_about: DataTableFramework channel registry. One entry per claimed channel range or adopted table.
Channels: ship /Game/DataTableFramework/<Composite>/ChNNNN.uasset in your own pak; nothing else.
Later parents win a same-named row: vanilla < adopted tables < Ch0001 < ... < Ch1000.
New rows should be prefixed C<NNNN>_ with your channel number. Rows that already shipped keep their names -- saves store parts by row name.
adopted: tables existing mods already add to a composite. The framework lists them as parents and ships an empty stub at each path, so those mods work unchanged.
One mod, one channel file. Claim a channel by adding it here before you release.
